story_type: shoulder-fired anti-tank missile live fire, launch to impact
hook: This missile leaves the tube before its rocket even lights.
narration: This soldier just fired a Javelin anti-tank missile from his shoulder.
Soldiers of the 2nd Cavalry Regiment fired them during Saber Strike sixteen near Tapa, Estonia.
A small charge kicks the missile out of the tube, and the main motor lights once it is clear.
The gunner locks onto the target before firing, and the missile steers itself the rest of the way.
Downrange, the target sat at the edge of the woods.
outcome: The Javelin found its target and hit it in a burst of fire and smoke.
title: Javelin missile, launch to impact
description:
Soldiers with the 2nd Cavalry Regiment fire FGM-148 Javelin anti-tank missiles during a combined arms live fire exercise for Saber Strike 16 near Tapa, Estonia, June 19, 2016.

Footage: U.S. Army video by Sgt. 1st Class Ben Houtkooper, 34th Red Bull Infantry Division, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/470653/javelins-fly-saber-strike-16-estonia
